name: manual_405373
claim: Before cherry-pick --continue (or after resolving a merge conflict), require BOTH: (1) `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` (or `git ls-files -u`) returns no paths -- the authoritative index-level check, since rename/delete and add/add conflicts leave no textual markers -- and (2) a supplemental scan of staged file content for conflict markers, since the index can be clean while a marker was accidentally staged as literal content. If markers shipped anyway, rewrite history with a clean cherry-pick; do not patch in a follow-up commit.
